 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Expected Soon, Intimation Slip Out, Check Exam Schedule
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 for Paper 1 will be released online at ssc.gov.in approximately 2–3 days before each candidate's scheduled exam date, between 23 November and 28 November 2026. The Exam City Intimation Slip has already been released. Candidates must log in using their registration credentials to download the city slip now and print their hall ticket.

 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will release the SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 around 2–3 days before each candidate's scheduled Paper 1 examination. The Paper 1 Computer-Based Examination (CBE) for Sub-Inspector (SI) recruitment in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) is scheduled from 23 November to 28 November 2026. 
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Expected Soon
 Ahead of the hall ticket release, the SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 has already been made live on the official portal. Registered applicants can check their allotted examination city right away and download their Paper 1 admission certificates from the official SSC website (ssc.gov.in) once activated. SAC CPO Hall ticket will be released 2-3 days before the exam. 
 Your hall ticket will carry essential particulars, including your exact exam date, shift timing, reporting time, and complete examination centre address.
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Overview
 With the SSC CPO Paper 1 exam city intimation link now active on the unified candidate portal, applicants should verify their allotted test city and travel plans immediately while waiting for the final admission certificate window to open.
 Exam Name: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2026
 Conducting Body: Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
 Paper: Paper 1 (Tier-I)
 Total Vacancies: 1,871 Posts
 Departments: Delhi Police, BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP and SSB
 Exam Dates: 23–28 November 2026
 City Intimation Slip: Released
 Admit Card Release: 2–3 days before the respective exam date
 Admit Card Mode: Online
 Exam Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT)
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Release Date
 According to the official notice issued by the Staff Selection Commission, the Paper 1 Admission Certificate is released approximately 2–3 days prior to a candidate's individual exam date. Because the recruitment test runs across six days from 23 November to 28 November 2026, hall tickets will roll out in phases rather than all on a single day.
 Candidates should monitor the official portal (ssc.gov.in) closely for exact activation confirmations. Based on the standard 2–3 day release window, check the date-wise schedule below:

 SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 Out
 The Staff Selection Commission has officially published the SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 for Paper 1 on its portal. Through this advance city live status, candidates can log in to view their allotted exam city, state, and scheduled exam date well before the admit card goes live, helping outstation aspirants book train or bus tickets on time.
 Important Clarification: The Exam City Intimation Slip is not your admit card. It does not display the exact venue address and cannot be used as an entry pass at the examination centre.
 Where to Check: Log in directly at the official SSC Candidate Portal ( ssc.gov.in ) under the " City Live / Admit Card Status " tab.
 Matriculation Discrepancy Alert: SSC has also flagged certain applications where matriculation (Class 10) details showed mismatches; affected candidates are being notified via email by their respective SSC Regional Offices and should review any instructions on their login dashboard before 20 November 2026.
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 Once activated for your exam date, the direct download link for the SSC CPO Paper 1 Hall Ticket 2026 will be accessible inside the unified candidate login module on ssc.gov.in (as well as through respective regional portals such as SSC NR, CR, ER, WR, SR, KKR, MPR, NWR, and NER where applicable). Candidates are strongly advised to download and print at least two clear copies of their admission certificate well before their exam shift.
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Download Link ( Active Soon) 
 How to Download SSC CPO Admit Card 2026?
 Follow these step-by-step instructions to download your Paper 1 hall ticket once the link is live:
 Visit the official Staff Selection Commission website at ssc.gov.in .
 Click on the Login / Register button on the homepage (or navigate to the Admit Card section).
 Select the relevant regional SSC website or proceed directly through the unified candidate dashboard.
 Locate and click on the SSC CPO Paper 1 Admit Card 2026 (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2026) link.
 Enter your Registration Number and Password (or Date of Birth) along with the captcha code.
 Click Submit / Login to access your admission certificate status.
 Your SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Verify every detail carefully, download the PDF, and print a clear copy for examination day.
 Details Mentioned on SSC CPO Hall Ticket 2026
 After downloading your hall ticket, cross-check all personal and exam-related entries to ensure there are no printing or spelling discrepancies:
 Candidate's Full Name
 Roll Number
 Registration Number
 Date of Birth & Category
 Candidate's Photograph and Signature
 Examination Name (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2026)
 Exam Date
 Exam Shift and Timing
 Reporting Time & Entry Closing Time
 Exam Centre Name and Complete Address
 Important Exam Day Instructions & Self-Declaration Form
 Documents Required Along With SSC CPO Hall Ticket 2026
 Entry into the CBT lab is strictly prohibited without valid verification documents. Make sure you pack the following items the night before your test:
 Printed Copy of SSC CPO Admit Card 2026: A clear, legible printout (preferably laser-printed) showing your photograph, barcode, and instructions.
 Valid Original Photo Identity Proof : Any one government-issued original ID containing your exact Date of Birth as printed on the admission certificate — such as an Aadhaar Card (or e-Aadhaar printout), Voter ID Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, or a valid Employer ID (for government employees). Note: Photocopies or digital photos on a mobile phone are not accepted.
 Supporting Date of Birth Proof (if needed): If your primary photo ID does not carry your complete Date of Birth (Day, Month, and Year), carry an additional original document with your full DOB (such as your Class 10 Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate).
 Recent Passport-Size Photographs: Carry at least two recent colour passport-size photographs matching your application form, as required per SSC exam-day guidelines.
 Additional Specific Documents: Any extra declaration or scribe-related paperwork explicitly mentioned in your admit card instructions.
 SSC CPO Exam Date and Shift Timing 2026
 SSC CPO Paper 1 Examination 2026 will be conducted in Computer-Based Mode across multiple shifts from 23 November to 28 November 2026. Paper 1 runs for a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes) and consists of 200 objective multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks across four sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, and English Comprehension (with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer).
 Shift Schedule & Timings: SSC releases individual shift timings, reporting windows, and gate-closing deadlines directly on each candidate's Paper 1 Admission Certificate.
 Follow Your Admit Card: Because shift allocations vary across exam days and centres, candidates must strictly follow the reporting time and gate closure deadline printed on their own individual admit card. No candidate is permitted inside the venue once the entry gate closes.
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 – Important Instructions
 Keep these essential exam-day rules in mind to avoid last-minute hassle at the test centre:
 Reach Before Reporting Time: Arrive at the venue at least 30–45 minutes prior to the reporting time printed on your hall ticket to complete biometric registration and frisking smoothly.
 Carry Mandatory Documents: Keep your printed SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 and original valid photo ID handy at the entrance gate.
 Verify Centre Location in Advance: Check the exact exam centre address and commute route a day before the exam, especially if your centre is in an unfamiliar city.
 Leave Prohibited Items Behind: Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, fitness bands, wallets, belts with metallic buckles, notebooks, and electronic gadgets are strictly banned inside the exam premises.
 Follow Photo & Identification Rules: Ensure your facial appearance matches your uploaded photograph and that the name and DOB on your ID match your hall ticket word-for-word.
 Read Hall Ticket Guidelines: Go through every point in the " Important Instructions for Candidates " section attached to your downloaded admit card before exam day.
 What to Do If You Cannot Download SSC CPO Admit Card 2026?
 If you run into trouble while accessing your Paper 1 hall ticket, check these common causes and fixes:
 Admit Card Not Yet Activated for Your Date: Remember that SSC unlocks the admit card only 2–3 days before your specific exam date. If your exam is on 27 November, your link will not be active on 21 November. Check your exam date on the City Intimation Slip first.
 Incorrect Registration Number or Password : Double-check your 11-digit SSC OTR Registration Number and password. Use the "Forgot Password" option on ssc.gov.in to reset credentials via your registered email ID or mobile number.
 High Server Traffic or Browser Cache Issues : Peak traffic right after release can slow down the portal. Clear your browser cache, switch to an incognito/private window, or try downloading during off-peak hours (late night or early morning).
 Application Rejection or Discrepancy: Verify your application status inside the candidate dashboard to ensure your form was accepted and any matriculation data notice has been addressed.
 Contact SSC Regional Office: If your exam is within 48 hours and the download still fails despite valid credentials, immediately contact the SSC Regional Office helpline corresponding to your exam city with your registration number, application printout, and ID proof.
 Candidates preparing for SSC CPO can practise using SSC CPO Previous Year Question Paper PDFs , including SSC CPO 2024 Tier 1 Question Paper PDFs , and follow the latest updates through the SSC CPO 2026 preparation resources . 
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 FAQs
 1. When will the SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 be released?
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will release the SSC CPO Paper 1 Admit Card 2026 approximately 2–3 days before each candidate's scheduled exam date. For candidates appearing on 23 November 2026, the hall ticket is expected around 20–21 November 2026. 2. Is the SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 out?
 Yes, the SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 is live on the official portal (ssc.gov.in). Registered candidates can log in with their Registration Number and Password to check their allotted exam city and exam date. 3. Can I enter the exam centre using the SSC CPO Exam City Slip?
 No. The Exam City Intimation Slip is issued solely to inform you of your test city and date in advance. You must download and print the official SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 to enter the examination hall. 4. What are the SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam Dates 2026?
